mapper.sql: id, username, password, name, type, department, phone, email
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.code FROM user_role ur LEFT JOIN role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT a.code FROM user_role ur LEFT JOIN role_authority ra ON ur.role_id = ra.role_id LEFT JOIN authority a ON ra.authority_id = a.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT FROM user
AND username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, password, name, type, department, phone, email) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{type}, #{department}, #{phone}, #{email})
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET username = #{username}, name = #{name}, type = #{type}, department = #{department}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email} WHERE id = #{id}
